title: Searching for Lost Objects with Postpositions

sections.content:
When searching for missing items, combine the verb **keres** (to look for) with postpositions:
- *Nézd meg az asztal alatt!* (Check under the table!)
- *A könyv mögött van?* (Is it behind the book?)
- *A táska a szék mellett van.* (The bag is next to the chair.)

items.spanish: Keresem a kulcsot, de nem találom.
items.english: I'm looking for the key, but I cannot find it.
There it is behind the box!
